youtube_title: White Spots On Nails = Low Calcium? Not Really | Body Fix #12 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #12. White spots on your nails, and family says LOW CALCIUM, drink milk!
Mostly B. A tiny knock at the nail base. The calcium thing is a MYTH.
Banged, bitten or picked nail: weeks later a white spot shows, then grows out.
Fix: Stop biting and picking, gloves for cleaning, moisturise cuticles.
Red flags: Whole nail white, lines on many nails, or shape changing? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: AAD / Cleveland Clinic - leukonychia
